answer: A vault escrows every alias and emits one seed; a willow counts that alias only after it drives the seed through the canyon by serial hashes, with alias k forced to append k new links after aliases 1…k−1 already exist, and any reused canyon state forfeits the vault. Alias one pays 1 link; ten aliases owe 55 dependent links before all ten count, so clones cannot split or parallelize the chain.
